ducon.title: Ducon Corretora de Seguros
ducon.location: Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil · On-site
highlights: Modernized legacy insurance systems using React and Laravel.
Containerized legacy applications with Docker, simplifying deployment and infrastructure management.
Improved deployment reliability by migrating applications to VPS environments.
Collaborated with marketing and product teams to maintain CMS-driven websites.
Collaborated on CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions to support automated build and deployment processes.

rocket_chat.title: Rocket.Chat
rocket_chat.location: Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil · Remote
highlights: Designed, developed, and delivered frontend features for a communication platform serving over 12 million users.
Led the migration of large frontend modules from JavaScript to TypeScript, modernizing approximately 30% of the codebase and improving maintainability and type safety.
Designed and implemented 5 reusable UiKit components used by Rocket.Chat marketplace applications, improving consistency and extensibility for third-party app developers.
Resolved more than 30 critical Omnichannel issues, improving platform stability and customer experience.
Reviewed more than 300 pull requests, improving code quality, consistency, and engineering standards across the frontend codebase.
Mentored frontend engineers through code reviews and technical guidance, helping improve TypeScript adoption and code quality across multiple squads.
Collaborated with Product Managers, Designers, and engineers to define scalable frontend architecture and deliver complex UI initiatives.
Improved frontend reliability, accessibility, and developer experience by expanding automated test coverage and enhancing shared component patterns with React Testing Library, Jest, and TypeScript.
